lastSession.summary: Strategic brainstorm on markymark distribution and tooling. Defined three-pillar distribution strategy: (1) Editor LSP clients (VSCode, Neovim, Zed), (2) Knowledge tool plugins (Obsidian, Logseq), (3) Agent tooling (MCP expansion, Claude Code skills, Agent SDK). Researched plugin sandbox constraints — Obsidian can spawn child processes, Logseq cannot. Decided on hybrid sidecar architecture: LSP stdio for editors, spawn for Obsidian, HTTP/localhost for Logseq. Identified ix3 (cross-language symbol bridging) as critical differentiator gating all distribution. Extended ix3 with three-tier extraction: backtick spans, code fences, prose references with confidence scoring. Created three distribution epics all depending on ix3.
